To gain weight you need to eat at a calorie surplus, take your TDEE and add 500 calories, to cut weight back and get lean you need a deficit, 500 is also what is typically recommended.

Eating and training at a surplus to gain weight is what we call bulking, during bulking most people gain a bit of chub due to eating an excess, so you can bulk up to your desired size and then cut down the calories while still training to drop body fat and get lean, or you can eat at a smaller surplus to stay lean from the beginning, how ever this will take you longer to gain the muscle mass you want.
